spec.requirement: A corpus states its requirements as blocks with a stable, repository-unique `id`, one of the five block kinds, a lifecycle `status` and a block `version`; the element name must equal `kind`. This block is the smallest requirement the published grammar accepts.
spec.verification: Read the block above: the requirement names this block through `verifies=`, the edge resolves, and the document conforms to `auger-spec-1.0.xsd`. A one-directional edge only — declaring `verifies=` on both sides is refused as `reference-cycle`.
